name: Diggi Multitrade Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2010, Diggi Multitrade Ltd is in 
the business of Real Estate and Construction[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
DML engages in trading real estate properties and building materials in select areas of the Mumbai suburbs, specifically Mira Road and Naigaon. Alongside these operations, the company also offers construction services, contributing to the development and infrastructure needs of these localities.

pros: Stock is trading at 1.08 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -1.43% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 663 days.
